Game Overview

Princess Summer Sand Castle is a dress up title where join Princess Anna and Elsa in a sunny beach adventure. Unleash your creativity by designing stylish beach outfits and accessorizing with chic jewelry. Dive into the fun of crafting stunning sandcastles and make unforgettable summer memories with the princesses.

How to Play

Princess Summer Sand Castle keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Join Princess Anna and Elsa in a sunny beach adventure! Unleash your creativity by designing stylish beach outfits and accessorizing with chic jewelry. Dive into the fun of crafting stunning sandcastles and make unforgettable summer memories with the princesses.
